sentences.en: I don't have a conscience, I only have a sensitivity.
IgE usually comes up in discussions about fleabite sensitivity.
sentences.zh: IgE（免疫球蛋白E）通常在跳蚤叮咬过敏的讨论中被提及。

sentences.en: I recommend earmuffs to help with your noise sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 我建议你使用耳塞来帮助缓解你的噪音敏感问题。
